en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4996 - Zur'ah narrated from Sama'ah who said:

The Imam (as) said: "If a man commits adultery and is flogged, it is not appropriate for the Imam to exile him from the land where he was flogged to another place. Rather, it is upon the Imam to expel him from the city in which he was flogged."
